title: Litmosis
tagline: Enabling Financial Institutions to monetize their Fiat or Crypto treasury by launching their own white-labeled stablecoins, pegged to any local currencies using Proof of Reserves/Multi-sig.
description:
Currently, there is more than $200T locked in Traditional Finance Institutions, bringing them on-chain not only helps them grow their business but also increases the adoption of DeFi. Currently, these Financial Institutions:
1) Need to figure out the Tech of launching their own stablecoins
2) Launching Multi-chain and bootstrapping liquidity for each chain is difficult
3) Building Proof of Reserves, Audits and Ecosystems take time, effort, and resources.

Use cases for Financial Institutions:
- Buy now pay later
- Microcredit and lending to SMEs
- Credit marketplace
- Personal retail investing
- Foreign exchange markets
how_its_made:
We ran challenges in:
1) Figuring out the seamless minting & burning  of ERC20 tokens
2) Figuring out cross-chain smart contract calls
